name: gi-uk-investment-income-treaty
description: UK–Gibraltar double-taxation agreement rules for dividends, interest, royalties and capital gains in 2026. Covers treaty residence, beneficial ownership, the property investment vehicle dividend exception, qualifying interest and royalty recipients, the strict foreign ownership threshold, permanent establishment connections, excessive related-party payments and principal-purpose restrictions. Includes property-rich disposal boundaries, source-tax ceiling examples and an evidence checklist for relief. Use for UK payments to Gibraltar residents and the reverse corridor. Includes the published company-interest relief evidence checklist; other withholding procedures and repayment deadlines need separate verification. This source-cited draft does not establish complete treaty coverage, independent source review or professional attestation.
